The built-in brush presets. In a script:
  {"cmd": "brush", "preset": "Pencil (graphite)", "color": "#2A2A30"}
(the colour stays as it was unless given; other fields change the preset)

Pencil (graphite)
  A soft graphite pencil: light pressure gives faint grey that catches the paper grain, pressing harder fills it in. Going over it again darkens it only so far.
  {"size":5.0,"opacity":0.85,"flow":1.0,"hardness":0.1,"spacing":0.1,"pressure_size":true,"pressure_opacity":true,"pressure_flow":false,"tip":"round","pressure_size_min":0.85,"pressure_opacity_min":0.15,"pressure_curve":1.4,"grain":0.75,"grain_scale":1.0,"build_up":0.8}

Ink pen
  Solid ink: always fully opaque, pressure only changes how thick the line is. Smoothing keeps long lines clean.
  {"size":6.0,"opacity":1.0,"flow":1.0,"hardness":1.0,"spacing":0.05,"pressure_size":true,"pressure_opacity":false,"pressure_flow":false,"tip":"round","pressure_size_min":0.15}

Marker
  A felt marker: even, a little see-through, the same width however hard you press. Overlapping strokes darken.
  {"size":24.0,"opacity":0.7,"flow":1.0,"hardness":0.95,"spacing":0.05,"pressure_size":false,"pressure_opacity":false,"pressure_flow":false,"tip":"round"}

Soft airbrush
  A big soft spray that builds up slowly where you linger or go over it. For shading and glows.
  {"size":120.0,"opacity":1.0,"flow":0.08,"hardness":0.0,"spacing":0.05,"pressure_size":false,"pressure_opacity":false,"pressure_flow":true,"tip":"round"}

Chalk
  Broken, grainy chalk that varies a little dab to dab. Good for texture and rough fills.
  {"size":30.0,"opacity":0.9,"flow":1.0,"hardness":0.6,"spacing":0.1,"pressure_size":true,"pressure_opacity":true,"pressure_flow":false,"tip":"chalk","dynamics":{"follow":true,"size":0.15,"angle":40.0,"opacity":0.2},"pressure_size_min":0.5,"pressure_opacity_min":0.3}

Soft eraser (an eraser: paint with `erase`)
  A big soft eraser for lifting pencil and fading edges; pressing harder makes it bigger.
  {"size":60.0,"opacity":1.0,"flow":1.0,"hardness":0.0,"spacing":0.05,"pressure_size":true,"pressure_opacity":false,"pressure_flow":false,"tip":"round","pressure_size_min":0.3}

Pixel pencil
  Pixel art: whole pixels, hard edges, nothing see-through. Size 1 draws one pixel at a time; zoom in to see the grid.
  {"size":1.0,"opacity":1.0,"flow":1.0,"hardness":1.0,"spacing":0.1,"pressure_size":false,"pressure_opacity":false,"pressure_flow":false,"pixel":true}

Pixel eraser (an eraser: paint with `erase`)
  Rubs out whole pixels, nothing half-erased: for pixel art.
  {"size":1.0,"opacity":1.0,"flow":1.0,"hardness":1.0,"spacing":0.1,"pressure_size":false,"pressure_opacity":false,"pressure_flow":false,"pixel":true}
